name: expo-yucheng-band
description: Local Expo module bridging the Yucheng (玉成创新科技) YCBT/YCProductSDK vendor BLE SDK — Android (ycbtsdk-release.aar) and iOS (YCProductSDK.framework) — into a single, minimal, platform-agnostic API surface: scan, connect, disconnect, read device info, and pull heart-rate/SpO2 vitals. Not published — consumed only by @tarragon/mobile via a file: dependency.
